meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 统一访问约 40 个生物信息学在线数据库,可检索蛋白、通路、化合物,并映射不同数据库的编号。
howto.when: 当任务需要在一个流程里用统一接口查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),或进行跨库 ID 映射、通路分析时触发;单库快速查询不适合;序列/文件操作用 biopython。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use Python to access 40+ bioinformatics web services through a consistent API, retrieving protein/pathway/compound data and mapping identifiers across databases.
howto.when_en: Use when querying multiple bioinformatics databases (e.g. UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) in one workflow, or doing cross-database ID mapping/pathway analysis. Not for single-database quick lookups; use biopython for sequence/file tasks.

say_en.note: Claude will call UniProt and do the ID mapping.
